status.offline: Offline - changes will be sent later

credentialsRequired: Both the username or email address and the password are required.
connectCodeRequired: Enter the code shown on the website's devices page.

changesRefused.one: One change could not be saved to your account, so it will not be kept on this device. This usually means whatever it belonged to was deleted on another device.
changesRefused.other: {count} changes could not be saved to your account, so they will not be kept on this device. This usually means whatever they belonged to was deleted on another device.

loggedOutOffline: Signed out on this device, but the server could not be reached, so this device may still be listed on your account.
deviceReturning: Welcome back. This device was signed out of "{name}" before, so it has picked up where it left off rather than being added to your account a second time.

deviceNameTaken.title: That name is already in use
deviceNameTaken.message: "{name}" is another device on your account, and it is signed in right now. If that device is this one, reinstalled, take it over - you keep its history and the old installation is signed out. Otherwise pick a different name, or keep both: two devices are allowed to share a name.

deviceTakenOver: This device is now "{name}", and the installation that held it has been signed out.
deviceNotRenamed: This device was not renamed - the server could not be reached.

signedOutNotice.tooltip: Sync is paused. Your links stay here and are sent when you log in again.

profile.LOCAL_ONLY_FREE_LIMIT: Not synchronised: the free plan synchronises {maximum} profile, and your account already has it. It stays on this device only.
profile.LOCAL_ONLY_FAIR_USE: Not synchronised: your account already synchronises as many profiles as the Fair Use Policy allows. It stays on this device only.
profile.EXAMPLE: Example data: not synchronised until you change it.

workspace.LOCAL_ONLY_FREE_LIMIT: This workspace stays on this device only: the free plan synchronises {maximum} workspaces per profile, and this profile already has them on your account.
workspace.LOCAL_ONLY_FAIR_USE: This workspace stays on this device only: it is over a fair use limit, or this profile already synchronises as many workspaces as the Fair Use Policy allows.
workspace.EXAMPLE: Example workspace: not synchronised until you change it, and removed when you log in if you leave it as it is.

workspaceOfProfile.LOCAL_ONLY_FREE_LIMIT: This profile and its workspaces stay on this device only: the free plan synchronises {maximum} profile, and your account already has it.
workspaceOfProfile.LOCAL_ONLY_FAIR_USE: This profile and its workspaces stay on this device only: your account already synchronises as many profiles as the Fair Use Policy allows.

unsynced.renameAdvice: Rename it to {names} and it merges with that one on your account at the next synchronisation.
unsynced.upgradeTooltip: Open your account on the website, where premium is bought
unsynced.auditTooltip: Open the devices page on the website, which shows what each installation holds and synchronises
